key_insight: RAD-2 combines diffusion-based trajectory generators with a discriminator trained via reinforcement-learning-style corrective feedback, stabilizing stochastic planners and improving closed-loop robustness for multimodal motion planning.
problem_solved: Addresses instability and lack of corrective negative feedback in diffusion-based motion planners trained with imitation learning, enabling reliable closed-loop behavior under multimodal future uncertainty.
method: Generator: diffusion-based multimodal trajectory sampler that models complex future distributions.
Discriminator: a critic that provides corrective feedback/rewards to the generator, closing the loop and counteracting stochastic instabilities.
Unified training: adversarial / RL-style optimization in closed-loop simulation to scale reinforcement learning signals for improved robustness and failure recovery.
impact: Enables practitioners to deploy multimodal, diffusion-based planners that are both expressive and robust in closed-loop control, reducing catastrophic failures and improving real-world autonomous driving performance.
